C1126.title: Shanghai Police Announce Case of AI-Generated Viral Online Rumors
C1126.summary: On April 16, 2024, the Shanghai Municipal Public Security Bureau held a press briefing to disclose typical cases from a special campaign against online rumors. One case involved the use of AI technology to mass-produce and fabricate sensational fake news and rumor content, which was then disseminated at scale online, illustrating how automated AI content generation was exploited for business fraud

references.title: Shanghai Police Deepen Special Campaign Against Online Rumors to Purify the Online Environment
